possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card provides only minimal architecture/modality/access info and no design, training, or evaluation details for Qwen1.5-4B.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card describes a base model and advises post-training before text generation, but does not define intended uses or downstream risk contexts.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not document training dataset details, collection, curation, or synthetic data generation for this checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Without access to the training data, the types of explanations a model can provide are limited and more likely to be incorrect.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight checkpoint card gives no access to training data, limiting explainability of outputs.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: No documentation of how training data was collected, curated, or used is stated in the card.

specifications.model_size: 7.4 GiB of safetensors weights (7,900,793,992 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model is a base language model, and the documentation advises applying post-training techniques such as SFT, RLHF, or continued pretraining before using it for text generation.
